body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The existing P104 relay proof excludes original private values because a descent violates ordinary source-support containment. This package proves that the **208 monotone-helper-lifetime floor survives free access to the entire eight-dimensional rational root code at every frame**, including the source projections of the eight retained private descents.

The new invariant is `p(V) in K + U(V)`. All 104 endpoint coordinate spaces meet K trivially, certified by explicit outside-root minors of determinant +/-512. Consequently the existing rank-eight required-support witnesses still force two proper-frame arrivals at every target. The package replays the complete original 4,058-event logical word over all 280 independent inputs and records the actual private source and dirty rows.

This is a written scoped proof with exact finite premises, author-checked with AI assistance. The 208 numerical floor is predecessor work; the permission to read K freely is the delta. Fixed data paths, increasing correction-helper paths, immutable sources, additive-only targets and input-independent rational coefficients remain essential. No 208-simultaneous-register claim, attaining construction, excess-rank invoice, new supplier or kappa is made. Native phases, correction construction/restoration, global hosting/moment, precision, reserves, tape and all-size admission remain unverified here.

Only `research/p104-private-code-relay-floor/` is added; frozen inputs and the selected result are unchanged.

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p104-private-code-relay-floor/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/p104-private-code-relay-floor/verify.py
```

The registered replay runs the optimized verifier and six CLI test groups; about six seconds locally. Direct output: `PASS_P104_PRIVATE_CODE_RELAY_FLOOR targets=104 private=8 code_rank=8 lifetimes=208 controls=12 no_new_kappa`. Canonical receipt SHA256: `7476014c671f32c3c1d97d189818af4784f4ac664a1bee73caf94f88289fa528`.

Twelve semantic/control groups cover puncture and rank mutations, missing query compensation/cleanup, outside-code private contamination, dependent support/minor witnesses, determinant signs, code-basis invariance, the actual private support escape and countermodels outside the claimed oracle/injectivity premises. Six CLI groups check a read-only Git-free export with all bytes unchanged, source/receipt drift, typed JSON, duplicate JSON keys and exclusive output. Normal/optimized receipts agree. The generated format-patch passes reverse-application checking against the committed tree.

The registered replay was run again on the final package bytes before submission, under an 8 GiB memory cap: it passed in about six seconds and left the worktree unchanged. I also checked by hand that the eight private coefficient rows in the README have determinant 1, so their source projections span all of K.

Finite replay certifies the stated source premises. The arbitrary-network implication is the written proof, not an exhaustive circuit search. No native Gaussian replay, full supplier/selected cold replay, hosted CI, independent human review or proof assistant is claimed.

## Open next questions

Trace one actual unfinished original G/Q/D source row outside K, check whether adding it defeats an endpoint's injectivity certificate, and then justify an actual read at the needed chronological frame. A useful escape must still restore dirt and pay for transport and hosting. Alternatively, change a source/target path or add a descent, explicitly naming the failed invariant premise before synthesis. Details and blockers are in the package's README and TASK.json.
